description: This file defines type guards and functions related to various content reference types within a domain model, including legacy references, tag-to-note references, and parent tag references. It also imports types and references from other modules in the project.

methods.name: isLegacyAnonymousReference
methods.description: Type guard to check if a ContentReference is a LegacyAnonymousReference based on its reference_type being undefined.

methods.name: isReference
methods.description: Type guard to verify if a ContentReference is a Reference by checking that reference_type is defined.

methods.name: isLegacyTagToNoteReference
methods.description: Type guard that determines if a LegacyAnonymousReference is a LegacyTagToNoteReference, considering the content_type and the current item's content_type.

methods.name: isTagToParentTagReference
methods.description: Type guard to check if a ContentReference is of type TagToParentTagReference based on reference_type matching ContentReferenceType.TagToParentTag.

ctags.name: isLegacyAnonymousReference
ctags.pattern: /^export const isLegacyAnonymousReference = (x: ContentReference): x is LegacyAnonymousReference =/

ctags.name: isReference
ctags.pattern: /^export const isReference = (x: ContentReference): x is Reference => {$/

ctags.name: isTagToParentTagReference
ctags.pattern: /^export const isTagToParentTagReference = (x: ContentReference): x is TagToParentTagReference => /
